name: cauldron
note: the cauldron (docs/47 section 3, #481): one prop with its fire under it, burning logs as the oven does and cooking nothing (`cooks` false: it boils no water and bakes nothing), brewing only while lit. The witch's at the mere is the map's (tools/mapgen/valley.py), never carried and not a village station; your own is the Cauldron item set down with Place (src/setdown.js) and picked up while it is out and empty. Drawn (art round 5): a black iron pot on three short legs over a ring of fieldstones, three logs and ash under it, two lugs and a bail; one drawing, lit from the top left and never mirrored (round, so one facing); its three flame frames stand under the pot, already cut where the pot, its legs, and the front log stand in front of them
